title: A lane runs the CI lint checks before it posts a fix check on a hand-resolved merge
why:
Lane lesson via the coordinator, 05:37 CST Nov 15 (relayed; the lane's account, not checked by triage). Three failed fix checks on #2787 each came from a defect of the lane's hand-resolved merge: cost pins, silent-undo, STE. Harm: each failed fix check counts as a review round (step review-fix-check-round), so a defect the CI lint checks would have read burns the three-round cap and forces a replacing PR (#3482). Idea (the lane's): run the CI lint checks (check_cost_pins, check_silent_undo, the STE check) on the merged head before a fix check is posted. Nearest steps, not the same: lane-lint-checks-from-batch (lane lint judges added lines with the batch's check scripts) and mixed-merge-resolver (who resolves a mixed conflict); neither runs the lint checks before a fix check (grep of roadmap steps for hand-resolved, pre-fix-check, fix check, 05:39 CST). Unmeasured: how often a hand-resolved merge fails a lint check; one incident (#2787, three times). Past rulings checked: none found.

09:28 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 09:27 CST, relayed): the lane on #3503 queued "lint-before-review" (run the lane lint checks before a review round) and says its own lane lint failed on two causes (step spec lists, Cost pins) after a fix check had already passed; the PR body says a third fix check followed. Second sighting of the family (first: #2787). Sighting only, no new step. The check set and its cost stay unmeasured.
source: lane sim-lease-gaps via coordinator 05:37 CST Nov 15, relayed by triage
note: Low. Open. One incident, three fix checks on #2787; the check set and its cost are unmeasured.
